material: JLC3DP SLS 3201 PA-F nylon, standard finish

service_states.heat_set: Empty base on a flat support. Insert tip, shank and handle travel vertically down each axis. Keep the lid and electronics off the base.
service_states.lower_screws: Lower controller only. Drive its three screws before seating the shield.
service_states.upper_screws: Both boards seated and both fuses in place. Drive the four shield screws with the lid off.
service_states.lid_screws: Closed lid. All four screw head seats and vertical driver paths accessible.
service_states.plug_service: Release each latch through the near edge relief and pull its cable mate horizontally.
service_states.fuse_service: Lift the lid vertically after removing its four screws. Lift the selected fuse with the case open.

source_notes.routed_shield: Source-pinned KiCad STEP, including its drawing-based port and holder bodies
source_notes.controller: UNO R3 nominal holes and headers. USB-C, jack and module placement are estimated from the seller images. The seller board drawing indicates a different left mounting-hole pattern.
source_notes.insert: Manufacturer STEP at the nominal installed position. Heat-set insert and raw pilot intentionally overlap in the cold CAD model.
source_notes.screws: Nominal M3 socket-head dimensions and hex socket. Threads represented by the screw envelope.
source_notes.cable_plugs: Molex drawing-based visual models. Clearance paths use the existing larger cable-mate envelopes.
